text: ここで　ボールを　なげるんだね　ぼく……　やってみるよ！

structure.jp: ここで　ボールを　なげるんだね
structure.en: so this is where I throw a Ball, right

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after the て-form means doing something to see how it goes. やってみる = 'I'll try doing it'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ after a verb shows the speaker has understood how things are, and ね checks it with the listener. なげるんだね = 'so I throw it, right'.
